thread:
katie-cs: Heads-up — ACME reported intermittent 401s from their production tenants plus elevated p95 latency. They filed a SIG/CAIQ and are asking for KMS rotation evidence and audit logs. Support ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/23456. Customer asking for evidence by EOD Thursday. Who can own?

alex: I can triage the auth side. Need repro steps + a sample request/response (headers redacted) and any timestamped logs. Any billing or retry spikes?

katie-cs: There was a billing spike yesterday from retries, customer noticed cost jump ~18%. I attached the support note in the ticket. For repro — they saw 401s from our hosted API (region us-west2) starting ~2029-06-14T18:10Z.

jamal: I pulled the logs for their org id (org_acme). Quick paste of the error window: ```
2029-06-14T18:10:03Z ERROR auth token validation failed user=svc-acme-client err=expired_token code=401
2029-06-14T18:10:04Z WARN request latency=1250ms route=/v1/generate
2029-06-14T18:10:07Z ERROR auth token validation failed user=svc-acme-client err=invalid_signature code=401
```

sre-bot: [ALERT] elevated p95 latency on hosted-api-us-west2 for org_acme between 18:09 and 18:12 UTC — 5xx rate 0.6% (baseline 0.1%)

alex: Thanks @jamal. Jamal — can you paste a minimal curl that reproduces the 401 (with fake token)? I'll try locally. Also, raj — can you check KMS access logs? Customer is explicitly asking for rotation timestamps + HSM-backed attestations.

raj: On it. For KMS audit export, run: ```
redwood-kms export-audit --org org_acme --from 2029-06-01T00:00Z --to 2029-06-15T00:00Z --format json --output /tmp/acme_kms_audit.json
```
Note: for HSM attestation we only have limited exports; I'll start a legal-approved evidence bundle.

alex: Repro curl (sanitized): ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer FAKE_TOKEN_EXPIRED" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"hello"}' -v
```
Response snippet: ```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":{"code":401,"message":"token expired"}}
```

jamal: That matches. Looks like the customer's token rotation job missed a window and started sending expired tokens; mixed with transient backend latency we saw more retries (hence billing spike). Recommend: 1) provide KMS rotation timestamps, 2) provide audit log export, 3) provide a short incident note for their SIG. I can also flush token cache if we want to force revalidation: ```
redwoodctl cache flush --scope=auth --org=org_acme
```

maria-security: I'll assemble the SIG/CAIQ evidence package. Need the KMS export + HSM attestation + the audit log export. Also confirm the retention policy they asked about: they requested 5 years for audit logs — our retention for hosted logs is 2 years by default. Do we have an exception?

raj: We do not have a long-term retention exception by default for hosted tenants. For Dedicated/Private we can offer extended retention. I can query archived buckets but if they need formal exception we need Sales/legal signoff.

katie-cs: Customer is pushing on due date (EOD Thu). Maria — can you confirm what we can deliver in 48 hours? I'll ask the customer to extend if needed.

maria-security: I can deliver the KMS rotation timestamps and the audit export within 24 hours. HSM attestation requires ops sign-off and might take 72 hours. I'll prepare a partial package and label outstanding items.

compliance-bot: Reminder — evidence downloads must be stored in the secure evidence vault. Use: https://vault.redwood.ai/upload and tag ticket 23456.

katie-cs: Perfect. Alex/jamal/raj — please drop the KMS export + cache flush confirmation + a short repro log into the ticket and then I will upload. Also, can someone confirm whether billing team needs to issue a one-time credit for retry-driven spike?

alex: I filed a billing review request: https://billing.redwood.ai/cases/7788 — assigned to billing@redwood.ai. Added the spike numbers and root cause (expired tokens).

jamal: I ran the cache flush at 2029-06-14T19:02Z and saw auth success rates return to baseline by 19:05Z. Pasting quick log: ```
2029-06-14T19:02:21Z INFO cache flush initiated by jamal for org_acme
2029-06-14T19:05:03Z INFO auth success user=svc-acme-client code=200
```

katie-cs: Closing loop — I'll update the customer with the partial package and ask for a 48 hour extension for HSM attestation. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
